description: Render HTML to a PDF with JavaScript and network access turned off, so only the HTML sent is used and images must be inline data URLs. options can set page-size (A3, A4, A5, Letter, Legal, Tabloid), orientation (Portrait, Landscape) and margin-top, margin-bottom, margin-left, margin-right such as 10mm. The PDF is stored for 24 hours: the answer has storage_id and storage_url, and read_stored_file returns the file. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: html_to_pdf
title: Render HTML to PDF
